ideas.title: Minnesota Nonprofit Fraud: A Growing Concern
ideas.description: Investigate the prevalence of nonprofit fraud in Minnesota, including the Feeding Our Future scheme and other cases.
questions: What is the scope of nonprofit fraud in Minnesota?
How can programs be protected from similar fraud?
ideas.insight: The recent sentencing and guilty pleas in Minnesota nonprofit fraud cases suggest a need for increased oversight and monitoring of programs to prevent similar fraud.

ideas.title: ICE Shooting Investigation: What Went Wrong
ideas.description: Investigate the ICE shooting of Lorenzo Salgado Araujo, including the investigation and potential wrongdoing by ICE agents.
questions: What were the circumstances surrounding the shooting?
ideas.insight: The investigation into the ICE shooting of Lorenzo Salgado Araujo raises questions about accountability and oversight within ICE.
